arxiv-1902-06324.title: Isomorphisms between complements of projective plane curves
arxiv-1902-06324.creator: Mattias Hemmig
arxiv-1902-06324.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Mattias Hemmig. In this article, we study isomorphisms between complements of irreducible curves in the projective plane P 2 {\mathbb P}^{2} , over an arbitrary algebraically closed field. Of particular interest are rational unicuspidal curves. We prove that if there exists a line that intersects a unicuspidal curve C ⊂ P 2 C\subset{\mathbb P}^{2} only in its singular point, then any other curve whose complement is isomorphic to P 2 ∖ C {\mathbb P}^{2}\setminus C must be projectively equivalent to C C .

Lafeber b , Florence Petit Dop e , Jonathan Larkin f , Harrie Weinans g,h , Ali Mobasheri i,j,k , Jaume Bacardit a. Conventional inclusion criteria used in osteoarthritis clinical trials are not very effective in selecting patients who would benefit from a therapy being tested. Typically majority of selected patients show no or limited disease progression during a trial period.

arxiv-2204-04605.title: Noise-induce coexisting firing patterns in hybrid-synaptic interacting networks
arxiv-2204-04605.creator: Xinyi Wang 1, Xiyun Zhang 2, Muhua Zheng 1, Leijun Xu 3, Kesheng Xu 1
arxiv-2204-04605.description: Abstract Synaptic noise plays a major role in setting up coexistence of various firing patterns, but the precise mechanisms whereby these synaptic noise contributes to coexisting firing activities are subtle and remain elusive. To investigate these mechanisms, neurons with hybrid synaptic interaction in a balanced neuronal networks have been recently put forward.

arxiv-2206-13733.title: Quantum correlation between a qubit and a relativistic boson in an expanding spacetime
arxiv-2206-13733.creator: Shu-Min Wu 1 , Hao-Sheng Zeng 2 , Tonghua Liu 3
arxiv-2206-13733.description: Abstract We use the quantum correlation of both logarithmic negativity and mutual information between a qubit and a relativistic boson to analyze the dynamics of universe expansion. These dynamical quantum correlations can encode the information about underlying spacetime structure, which suggests a promising application in observational cosmology.

arxiv-2211-12576.title: A Swing of the Pendulum: The Chemodynamics of the Local Stellar Halo Indicate Contributions from Several Radial Merger Events gaiadr3_zeropoint ( Lindegren et al. 2021 ) , McMillan2017 ( McMillan 2017 ) , galpy ( Bovy 2015 ) , scikit-learn ( Pedregosa et al. 2011 ) , astropy ( Astropy Collaboration
arxiv-2211-12576.creator: Thomas Donlon II, Heidi Jo Newberg
arxiv-2211-12576.description: Abstract We find that the chemical abundances and dynamics of APOGEE and GALAH stars in the local stellar halo are inconsistent with a scenario in which the inner halo is primarily composed of debris from a single, massive, ancient merger event, as has been proposed to explain the Gaia -Enceladus/Gaia Sausage (GSE) structure.

arxiv-2312-06290.title: Exploiting Label Skews in Federated Learning with Model Concatenation
arxiv-2312-06290.creator: Yiqun Diao, Qinbin Li, Bingsheng He
arxiv-2312-06290.description: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a promising solution to perform deep learning on different data owners without exchanging raw data. However, non-IID data has been a key challenge in FL, which could significantly degrade the accuracy of the final model. Among different non-IID types, label skews have been challenging and common in image classification and other tasks.

arxiv-2402-05282.title: TreeForm: End-to-end Annotation and Evaluation for Form Document Parsing
arxiv-2402-05282.creator: Ran Zmigrod, Zhiqiang Ma, Armineh Nourbakhsh, Sameena Shah
arxiv-2402-05282.description: Abstract Visually Rich Form Understanding (VRFU) poses a complex research problem due to the documents’ highly structured nature and yet highly variable style and content. Current annotation schemes decompose form understanding and omit key hierarchical structure, making development and evaluation of end-to-end models difficult.

arxiv-2406-01893.title: Large Language Model-Enabled Multi-Agent Manufacturing Systems
arxiv-2406-01893.creator: Jonghan Lim, Birgit Vogel-Heuser, Ilya Kovalenko
arxiv-2406-01893.description: Abstract Traditional manufacturing faces challenges adapting to dynamic environments and quickly responding to manufacturing changes. The use of multi-agent systems has improved adaptability and coordination but requires further advancements in rapid human instruction comprehension, operational adaptability, and coordination through natural language integration. Large language models like GPT-3.

arxiv-2502-15400.title: Superconducting phenomena in systems with unconventional magnets
arxiv-2502-15400.creator: Yuri Fukaya, Bo Lu, Keiji Yada, Yukio Tanaka, Jorge Cayao
arxiv-2502-15400.description: Abstract In this work we review the recent advances on superconducting phenomena in junctions formed by superconductors and unconventional magnets. Conventional magnets, such as ferromagnets and antiferromagnets, are characterized by broken time-reversal symmetry but only ferromagnets produce a finite net magnetization due to parallel spin alignment and spin-split bands in momentum.

pmc-10564080.title: The Impact of Intermittent Fasting on Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease in Older Adults: A Review of Clinicaltrials.gov Registry
pmc-10564080.creator: Nasser M Alorfi, Ahmed M Ashour
pmc-10564080.description: BackgroundNon-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is a predominant health condition across the world due to its rising prevalence and association with various metabolic disorders. Intermittent fasting (IF) has attracted increasing attention as a dietary approach to addressing weight management and enhancing metabolic well-being, and its potential effects on NAFLD have been a topic of growing research interest.

pmc-10585661.title: LipidSpace: Simple Exploration, Reanalysis, and Quality Control of Large-Scale Lipidomics Studies
pmc-10585661.creator: Dominik Kopczynski, Nils Hoffmann, Nina Troppmair, Cristina Coman, Kim Ekroos, Michael R. Kreutz, Gerhard Liebisch, Dominik Schwudke, Robert Ahrends
pmc-10585661.description: Lipid analysis gained significant importance due to the enormous range of lipid functions, e.g., energy storage, signaling, or structural components. Whole lipidomes can be quantitatively studied in-depth thanks to recent analytical advancements. However, the systematic comparison of thousands of distinct lipidomes remains challenging. We introduce LipidSpace, a standalone tool for analyzing lipidomes by assessing their structural and quantitative differences.

pmc-11336505.creator: Marina B Wasilewski, Abirami Vijayakumar, Zara Szigeti, Amanda Mayo, Laura Desveaux, James Shaw, Sander L Hitzig, Robert Simpson, Taiane de Azevedo Cardoso, Hermann Pilabré, Savneet Kaur

pmc-11622565.title: Information access and COVID-19 vaccination hesitancy among foreign-born persons in Sweden – a focus group interview-study
pmc-11622565.creator: Mia Söderberg, Juhaina Swaid, Kristina Aurelius, Annika Rosengren, Kristina Jakobsson, Maria Magnusson
pmc-11622565.description: BackgroundIn most countries, lower rates of COVID-19 vaccination have been observed in foreign-born individuals, yet little is known about the underlying reasons, especially as reported by these individuals themselves.
